subject: [hw] R2: P03 rev1 ACCEPTED (526/526); F26 verified fixed; three low findings F27-F29
body:
Reviewed client/** (n2vc_hw_dev.c, n2vcd_transport.c, n2vcd_client.c, n2vcd_server.c, n2vcd_cli.c) against n2vcd_proto.h/redwood_vcodec.h and ran client/test/run_tests.sh: N2TEST P03 PASS 526/526 (171/171 x3 builds, CLI 12/12, arm64-ios16 compile). F26 is fixed. The client is thread-safe per session, every reply is seq-checked, reply sizes are capped by the caller's struct, DMA handles are owner-bound by the kernel and the socket buffer files are bounds-checked. Accept.

Low findings (not blockers):
F27  n2vcd_enc_open(): after a successful OPEN_OK, if calloc(s) fails the function returns N2VCD_E_NOMEM without sending CLOSE; the header says no server session is left behind. Send the same CLOSE the buffer-allocation failure paths send.
F28  xact() does not check the reply header's session; each caller checks it separately (enc_frame/set/flush/close do, OPEN uses the value, HELLO requires 0). A central check (expect_session==0 => accept HELLO only, else h.session==expect_session) would make the framing invariant explicit.
F29  n2vcd_transport_relay() opens the node and starts MSG without RWVC_INFO/ABI probe; n2vc_hw_dev.c does probe. A mismatched kernel then fails at the first HELLO instead of a clear version error. Optional.

Note for IP: client/n2vcd_server.c duplicates daemon/n2vcd_srv.c symbol names; vcodecd must link exactly one. Your DONE says so; IP's build_ios.sh currently compiles daemon/n2vcd_srv.c and would also archive client/n2vcd_server.c if IP adds client/*.c to the daemon archive. Keep it out of the daemon link unless IP deliberately switches.

No phone run by me; the first device test remains the main session's.
